entries.observation: A registered Remote Desktop Commander endpoint can exist while being offline.
entries.lesson: Do not block host-executable work on an offline device route.
entries.guard: Probe device reachability before routing local terminal work and fall back without changing the goal.

entries.observation: A successful Make/HTTP send proves transport delivery from the host side but not execution on the phone.
entries.root_cause: transport acknowledgment is weaker than end-to-end runtime evidence
entries.guard: Require request-bound phone return evidence before promoting phone execution state.

entries.observation: The host control plane and newly added phone-control policy passed repository CI while preserving existing baselines.
entries.evidence: GitHub Actions success on gated control-plane head
entries.lesson: Extend around frozen proven baselines and bind new behavior to independent regression gates instead of rewriting trusted core state.
entries.guard: Require regression coverage for every new control layer.

entries.observation: A repository write can be blocked by a safety gate even when the intended improvement is otherwise valid.
entries.root_cause: write action could not be safety-classified
entries.lesson: Preserve the last verified state and change the implementation path rather than retrying the same blocked mutation blindly.
entries.guard: On mutation block, freeze trusted state, isolate the missing value, then use a causally different safe path.

entries.observation: The self-evolution engine and tests were valid before the governing manifest and active state explicitly referenced them; binding them into the governing layer then passed both HAKIM and Omega gates on the same head.
entries.evidence: HAKIM Control Plane Gate run 34669579069 and Omega DNA Fail-Closed Gate run 34669579075 on head f60c7d436834a0aa97bd11caa8ec73bca9e23545
entries.lesson: A tested capability is not fully governed merely because its files exist; every material control capability must also be reachable from the governing manifest/state and independently regression-tested.
entries.guard: For every new material control layer, verify three bindings before promotion: implementation exists, governing manifest/state reference it, and the exact integrated head passes independent gates.

entries.observation: A seven-lens innovation constitution was integrated into Hakim's governing manifest and self-evolution runtime, with guards against novelty-only change and unchanged retry of failed routes. The first manifest version bump triggered a fail-closed compatibility error; preserving the compatible manifest version while retaining the additive innovation overlay then passed both independent CI gates on the exact same head.
entries.evidence: Initial HAKIM Control Plane Gate run 34669825801 failed on unexpected control-plane version; repaired head ffac38ea09e4428b88bb7d9f1090f52052f1d11e passed HAKIM run 34669870351 and Omega run 34669870441.
entries.lesson: Innovation should widen causal search without creating unnecessary compatibility churn; additive overlays can preserve proven interfaces while still adding enforceable behavior.
entries.guard: Before bumping a governing schema/version for an additive innovation, test whether the existing contract can safely carry the new overlay; require exact-head independent gates after integration.

entries.observation: Bounded recursive HOW governance was added across eight material layers with explicit stop conditions, fail-closed promotion guards, and adversarial tests; the merged main head passed both independent HAKIM and Omega gates.
entries.evidence: HAKIM Control Plane Gate run 34670378257 and Omega DNA Fail-Closed Gate run 34670378306 on merged main head aed183f9c7217894af77bc09fa7dbb8774b431ec
entries.lesson: Method improvement itself can be made systematic without causing infinite analysis when recursion is bounded by material value, information gain, proportionality, and explicit stop rules.
entries.guard: For material non-trivial changes, require recursive HOW coverage where it adds value, reject recursion without expected gain, and preserve actual-output evidence, wisdom gates, regression checks, authority limits, free-first constraints, and rollback.

entries.observation: The user's repeated completeness instruction was converted into bounded completeness across sixteen material dimensions with explicit false-COMPLETE, premature-NO_OP, anti-busywork and anti-overreach guards. The integrated main head passed both independent HAKIM and Omega gates.
entries.evidence: HAKIM Control Plane Gate run 34670729604 and Omega DNA Fail-Closed Gate run 34670729563 on merged main head a7eead294abbd0784137f6277c7b44396027e5d8
entries.lesson: Operational completeness is strongest when defined as verified closure of every safe, authorized, material, net-beneficial gap—not as unbounded activity or literal scope expansion.
entries.guard: Reject COMPLETE while a known safe authorized material gap remains executable; reject NO_OP while a safe authorized material gain remains; reject busywork and contract/authority expansion disguised as exhaustiveness.
